description: Bitcoin: Projected blocks for fee estimation, up to eight as mempool.space's. Block 0 is Bitcoin Core's `getblocktemplate` selection; the rest are packed after it as Core's block assembler packs (whole CPFP chunks by feerate, in dependency order, within Core's default weight and sigop budgets), ranked by the node's signed modified fees (including `prioritisetransaction`; mining options shape block 0 only), with paid fees in the statistics. The last holds whatever is left: more than a block when the mempool is busy. `GET /api/mempool-blocks/{index}` serves each with its transactions, except such a last one.
name: get_mempool_blocks
title: Projected mempool blocks
